english: Asks for a PIN, password or code
Kinyarwanda_draft: Irasaba PIN, ijambo ry'ibanga cyangwa kode

english: Genuine banks, mobile-money companies and officials do not ask you to send or read out a PIN, password or one-time code.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Banki, ibigo bya mobile money n'abayobozi nyakuri ntibasaba kohereza cyangwa kuvuga PIN, ijambo ry'ibanga cyangwa kode y'inyongera.

english: Do not send or read out the code. Contact the organisation using a number from its official website or your card.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntukohereze cyangwa ngo uvuge iyo kode. Hamagara ikigo ukoresheje nimero iri ku rubuga rwacyo rwemewe cyangwa ku ikarita yawe.

english: Asks you to pay first to receive something
Kinyarwanda_draft: Irasaba kubanza kwishyura kugira ngo ubone ikintu

english: Scams often ask for a small 'fee' before a prize, loan, parcel or scholarship is released. The reward never arrives.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Abatekamutwe bakunze gusaba 'amafaranga make' mbere yo kukugezaho igihembo, inguzanyo, ipaki cyangwa buruse. Igihembo ntikiza.

english: Do not pay. Check with the organisation directly, using contact details you find yourself.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntukishyure. Baza ikigo ubwacyo ukoresheje amakuru wibonera ubwawe.

english: Asks you to install remote-control software
Kinyarwanda_draft: Irasaba gushyira kuri telefoni porogaramu yo kuyigenzura kure

english: Remote-access apps let someone see and control your phone or bank app.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Porogaramu zo kugenzura kure zituma undi muntu abona kandi agakoresha telefoni yawe cyangwa porogaramu ya banki.

english: Do not install it. End the conversation and contact your bank through its official channel.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntuyishyire kuri telefoni. Hagarika ikiganiro maze uvugane na banki yawe unyuze mu nzira yemewe.

english: Says money was sent by mistake and asks for it back
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ivuga ko amafaranga yoherejwe kubw'impanuka kandi irayasaba

english: A common trick: a fake or reversed payment, then a request to 'return' the money.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Uburiganya buzwi: bohereza amafaranga y'ibinyoma, hanyuma bagusaba 'kuyasubiza'.

english: Check your own balance in your official app or at an agent. Do not send money back until you have confirmed it really arrived.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Reba amafaranga ufite muri porogaramu yemewe cyangwa ku mukozi. Ntusubize amafaranga utarabyemeza ko yaje koko.

english: Says you won or were selected for a prize
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ivuga ko watsinze cyangwa watoranyijwe guhabwa igihembo

english: Unexpected prize messages are among the most common scams. You cannot win a draw you never entered.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ubutumwa buvuga ko watsindiye igihembo utazi ni bumwe mu buriganya busanzwe. Ntushobora gutsinda tombola utigeze ugiramo uruhare.

english: Ignore it unless you know you entered. Never pay or share personal details to 'claim' a prize.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntibugire icyo bukubwira keretse ubizi ko wagiye muri iyo tombola. Ntukishyure cyangwa ngo utange amakuru bwite 'kugira ngo uhabwe' igihembo.

english: Threatens to block or close your account or SIM
Kinyarwanda_draft: Iragutera ubwoba ko konti cyangwa SIM yawe izafungwa

english: Fear of losing access is used to rush people into clicking or sharing details.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ubwoba bwo gutakaza konti bukoreshwa kugira ngo abantu bihute gukanda cyangwa gutanga amakuru.

english: Do not follow links in the message. Open your official app or visit the provider yourself to check.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntukande amahuza ari mu butumwa. Fungura porogaramu yemewe cyangwa ujye ku kigo ubwawe urebe.

english: Asks you to verify or update account details
Kinyarwanda_draft: Irasaba kwemeza cyangwa kuvugurura amakuru ya konti

english: 'Verify your account' messages are often used to collect your login or ID details.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ubutumwa busaba 'kwemeza konti' bukunze gukoreshwa mu gukusanya amakuru yo kwinjira cyangwa indangamuntu.

english: Do not use links or numbers from the message. Go to the official website or branch yourself.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntukoreshe amahuza cyangwa nimero ziri mu butumwa. Jya ku rubuga rwemewe cyangwa ku biro ubwawe.

english: Contains a link that hides or disguises its destination
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ifite ihuza ritagaragaza aho rijya

english: Shortened links, raw IP addresses and unusual web endings are often used to hide a fake site.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Amahuza magufi, aderesi z'imibare n'iherezo ridasanzwe ry'urubuga bikunze gukoreshwa mu guhisha urubuga rw'uburiganya.

english: Do not open it. Type the organisation's official address yourself.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntuyifungure. Andika ubwawe aderesi yemewe y'ikigo.

english: Promises unrealistic money
Kinyarwanda_draft: Isezeranya amafaranga adashoboka

english: Guaranteed or very fast returns are a classic sign of an investment scam.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Inyungu zemewe cyangwa zihuta cyane ni ikimenyetso gisanzwe cy'uburiganya mu ishoramari.

english: Do not invest. Check whether the company is registered with the proper authority.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntugashore. Reba niba ikigo cyanditse mu rwego rubifitiye ububasha.

english: Asks for a payment up front for an offer (job, loan)
Kinyarwanda_draft: Irasaba kwishyura mbere ku mirimo cyangwa inguzanyo

english: A real employer or lender does not ask for insurance, visa or processing money before paying you or starting work.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Umukoresha cyangwa umuguzanyi nyawe ntasaba amafaranga y'ubwishingizi, viza cyangwa ay'ibyangombwa mbere yo kuguha amafaranga cyangwa akazi.

english: Do not pay anything up front. Check the offer with the organisation using contact details you find yourself.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntukishyure mbere. Baza ikigo ukoresheje amakuru wibonera ubwawe.

english: Pretends to be a relative in trouble and asks for money
Kinyarwanda_draft: Yiyita umuvandimwe ufite ikibazo igusaba amafaranga

english: Scammers claim to be a family member with a new number or an emergency so you send money before thinking.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Abatekamutwe biyita abavandimwe bafite nimero nshya cyangwa ikibazo kugira ngo wohereze amafaranga utabanje gutekereza.

english: Call the person on their old number, or ask a question only they could answer, before sending anything.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Hamagara uwo muntu kuri nimero ye isanzwe, cyangwa umubaze ikibazo wenyine azi, mbere yo kohereza ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose.

english: Pushes you to continue a job offer on WhatsApp or Telegram
Kinyarwanda_draft: Igukururira kuri WhatsApp cyangwa Telegram ku kazi

english: Fake job offers quickly move the conversation to a private chat so nobody can check them.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Amatangazo y'akazi y'ibinyoma ahita yimura ikiganiro kuri messagerie yihariye kugira ngo hatagira ugenzura.

english: Check the company and the recruiter on official sources before replying.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Genzura ikigo n'uwakoresha mu nzira zemewe mbere yo gusubiza.

english: Asks you to buy gift cards or vouchers for someone
Kinyarwanda_draft: Igusaba kugura amakarita y'impano cyangwa ama-vocha

english: Scammers pose as a boss or official and ask for gift-card codes because they are hard to trace or reverse.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Abatekamutwe biyita abayobozi bagusaba kode z'amakarita y'impano kuko bigoye kuzikurikirana cyangwa kuzisubiza.

english: Do not buy or send codes. Confirm the request face to face or by calling the person on a number you already know.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntugure cyangwa ngo wohereze kode. Emeza icyo gusaba imbonankubone cyangwa uhamagare uwo muntu kuri nimero usanzwe uzi.

english: Uses time pressure
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ikoresha igitutu cy'igihe

english: Urgency alone is common in normal messages. It matters only when combined with other warning signs.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Kwihutisha ubwabyo bikunze kuba mu butumwa busanzwe. Bifite uburemere gusa iyo byiyongereye ku bindi bimenyetso.

english: Take a minute to check before acting.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Fata umunota wo kugenzura mbere yo gukora.

english: Asks you to keep it secret
Kinyarwanda_draft: Irasaba kubigira ibanga

english: Scammers often ask for secrecy so family or friends cannot warn you.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Abatekamutwe bakunze gusaba ibanga kugira ngo umuryango cyangwa inshuti zitakuburira.

english: Talk to someone you trust before acting.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Vugana n'umuntu wizeye mbere yo gukora.

english: Contains a link
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ifite ihuza

english: Most messages with links are harmless; links matter when other warning signs are present.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ubutumwa bwinshi bufite amahuza ntibubi; amahuza agira uburemere iyo hari ibindi bimenyetso.

english: Prefer typing official addresses yourself.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ahubwo wandike ubwawe aderesi zemewe.

english: No known warning signs detected
Kinyarwanda_draft: Nta bimenyetso by'uburiganya bizwi byabonetse

english: Verify before acting
Kinyarwanda_draft: Banza ugenzure mbere yo gukora

english: Multiple high-risk indicators detected
Kinyarwanda_draft: Hari ibimenyetso byinshi by'ibyago bikomeye

english: This is a decision aid, not a guarantee. A message with no warning signs can still be a scam.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Iki ni igikoresho cyunganira ibyemezo, ntabwo ari ingwate. Ubutumwa butagaragaza ibimenyetso na bwo bushobora kuba uburiganya.

english: Do not click links or call numbers from a message you did not expect.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntukande amahuza cyangwa ngo uhamagare nimero ziri mu butumwa utari witeze.

english: Never share a PIN, password or one-time code with anyone.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ntugatange PIN, ijambo ry'ibanga cyangwa kode y'inyongera ku muntu uwo ari we wese.

english: Contact the organisation using details from its official website, card or branch.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Vugana n'ikigo ukoresheje amakuru ari ku rubuga rwemewe, ku ikarita cyangwa ku biro.

english: Talk to someone you trust before sending money.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Vugana n'umuntu wizeye mbere yo kohereza amafaranga.

english: Check a message before you click, pay or share a code.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Genzura ubutumwa mbere yo gukanda, kwishyura cyangwa gutanga kode.

Kinyarwanda_draft: Ibyerekeye KinyaShield RW

english: KinyaShield explains why a message may be suspicious, in English, French, Kinyarwanda and Kiswahili.
Kinyarwanda_draft: KinyaShield isobanura impamvu ubutumwa bushobora kuba uburiganya, mu Cyongereza, Igifaransa, Ikinyarwanda n'Igiswahili.

english: It uses written rules you can read, not a hidden model. Every warning shows the exact words that caused it.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ikoresha amategeko yanditse ushobora gusoma, ntabwo ari ikoranabuhanga rihishe. Buri muburo werekana amagambo yawuteye.

english: It is a decision aid. It cannot prove a message is safe, and it can miss new tricks, especially messages that sound normal.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Ni igikoresho cyunganira ibyemezo. Ntigishobora kwemeza ko ubutumwa butekanye, kandi gishobora kudatahura amayeri mashya.

english: Rules and wording in French, Kinyarwanda and Kiswahili are drafts until fluent speakers have reviewed them.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Amategeko n'amagambo mu Gifaransa, Ikinyarwanda n'Igiswahili ni igerageza kugeza ubwo abakizi neza bazayasuzuma.

english: Tested only on short fictional messages written by the project owner. Real-world accuracy is not yet known.
Kinyarwanda_draft: Cyagerageshejwe gusa ku butumwa bugufi bw'impimbano bwanditswe na nyiri umushinga. Ukuri mu buzima busanzwe ntikurazwi.
